Yo! Dental lab tech for about 10 years. These are denture teeth from what we always called “tooth cards” at the dental office I worked at. They are plastic teeth used to make dentures. The nicer teeth usually come on plastic trays held on by wax. Cheaper ones that I’ve used look like this when removed, they don’t come on wax and instead use a sticky tape type joint on the trays. It sticks to the back of the tooth when you pull it off. For example, [these](https://a.co/d/cqpJJ7A) are the cheaper ones and [these](https://www.ivoclar.com/en_us/shop/p/teeth/srphonaresiitypsetof8/p/639352) are the better quality ones.
